# Inland Empire Lung & Sleep Institute (IE Lung)

> Inland Empire Lung & Sleep Institute is a specialized pulmonary and sleep medicine clinic located in Redlands, California. We provide comprehensive, science-driven, and patient-centered diagnostics and treatments for complex respiratory conditions, lung diseases, and sleep disorders.

## About the Practice
- **Location:** 245 Terracina Boulevard, Suite 108, Redlands, CA 92373
- **Phone:** (909) 938-1152
- **Fax:** (909) 453-3676
- **Email:** contact@ielung.com
- **Website:** https://ielung.com
- **Hours:** Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST
- **Service Areas:** Redlands, San Bernardino County, Riverside County, and the broader Inland Empire region of Southern California.

## Core Clinical Services & Specialized Testing

### 1. Pulmonary Function Testing (PFT) & Asthma Diagnostics
- **URL:** https://ielung.com/services/pulmonary-function-testing
- **Description:** Non-invasive lung function evaluation measuring airflow, lung volume, and gas exchange.
- **Procedures Offered:**
  - Spirometry (evaluates airway obstruction like COPD and asthma)
  - Lung Volume Testing / Body Plethysmography
  - Diffusing Capacity of the Lungs for Carbon Monoxide (DLCO)
  - Upright and Supine Vital Capacity (diaphragm function)
  - Bronchodilator Response Testing
  - Exercise Bronchoprovocation (exercise-induced asthma)
  - Peak Expiratory Flow Measurement
  - Respiratory Muscle Strength (MIP / MEP)

### 2. Sleep Studies & Diagnostics
- **URL:** https://ielung.com/services/sleep-studies-diagnostics
- **Description:** Comprehensive in-lab and home diagnostics for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), insomnia, narcolepsy, and daytime fatigue.
- **Procedures Offered:**
  - Home Sleep Apnea Testing (HSAT)
  - In-Laboratory Polysomnography (PSG)
  - PAP / CPAP / BiPAP Titration Studies (including split-night studies)
  - Multiple Sleep Latency Test (MSLT)
  - Maintenance of Wakefulness Test (MWT)
  - Overnight Pulse Oximetry

### 3. Advanced Bronchoscopy & Interventional Pulmonology
- **URL:** https://ielung.com/services/advanced-bronchoscopy
- **Description:** Minimally invasive airway procedures and biopsies to diagnose lung nodules, central chest lesions, and pleural effusions without traditional surgery.
- **Procedures Offered:**
  - Robotic Bronchoscopy (navigating peripheral lung nodules)
  - Endobronchial Ultrasound (EBUS) with fine needle aspiration
  - Flexible Bronchoscopy with Bronchoalveolar Lavage (BAL)
  - Bronchoscopy-Guided Lung Biopsy
  - Ultrasound-Guided Thoracentesis (fluid drainage and pleural evaluation)

### 4. Pulmonary Vascular & Cardiac Evaluation
- **URL:** https://ielung.com/services/pulmonary-vascular-diseases
- **Description:** Specialized diagnostic testing and physician interpretation for pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and pulmonary thromboembolic diseases.
- **Procedures Offered:**
  - Right-Heart Catheterization (RHC)
  - Acute Vasoreactivity Testing
  - CT Pulmonary Angiography (CTPA) interpretation
  - Electrocardiogram (ECG / EKG) Interpretation

### 5. Exercise, Oxygen & High-Altitude Testing
- **URL:** https://ielung.com/services/exercise-oxygen-high-altitude-testing
- **Description:** Functional assessments measuring cardiovascular, pulmonary, and metabolic responses under exertion and lower oxygen environments.
- **Procedures Offered:**
  - Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing (CPET)
  - Six-Minute Walk Test (6MWT)
  - High-Altitude Simulation Testing (HAST / "Fit-to-Fly" clearance)
  - Ambulatory Oximetry & Oxygen Prescription Titration
  - Blood Gas Analysis (ABG) Interpretation
  - Resting Pulse Oximetry
